headline: Guardians of the Galaxy comes to Switch 2!
title: Guardians of the Galaxy Encore Edition November 5 | Switch 2 Release | Gaming News
video_script: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy is coming to Nintendo Switch 2! The Encore Edition launches on November fifth, twenty twenty six, as a Switch 2 exclusive. It brings the story adventure from Eidos Montreal to Nintendo's new console, and adds new nineteen eighties glam rock outfits for Star-Lord, Drax, Gamora, Rocket and Groot. Pre-orders are listed at thirty nine dollars and ninety nine cents. Will you play it on Switch 2? Comment below!
